explicit_limitation: This interval (A→B) measures ONLY the internal processing latency from SFML event dequeue to gameplay engine direction registration. It EXCLUDES: OS keyboard driver buffering, SFML event queue waiting (time from key press to dequeue). Classification: INTERNAL LOWER BOUND. Not an end-to-end TC-PERF-02 pass.

display_latency_us.note: displayed_us - dequeued_us; includes render frame + V-Sync wait

acceptance_gap: TC-PERF-02 specifies end-to-end input acknowledgement <100ms including OS queue. Internal lower bound (1-6µs) far exceeds acceptance, but full end-to-end including OS/SFML waiting was not measured. 100% of inputs recorded in order, 0 dropped. The internal measurement is valid diagnostic data, not a full acceptance pass.
